answer: Random transcript audit works like a customs inspection at the inlet of a harbor: the chain samples one past answer per epoch, issues a fresh nonce at that summit of re-verification, and demands the author re-derive its reasoning live, so no reply can be pre-baked. The verifier recomputes the stored derivation against the live transcript; a single mismatch freezes emission, two mismatches trigger slashing of the bonded deposit. Replaying 8,192 identities costs roughly 1.2 million tokens and 36 hours of GPU time, a tide of capital that makes sockpuppet farming uneconomic.
